name: OpenAI redacted key display
description: The redacted_value returned when an existing project API key is retrieved, shown in the reference as sk-abc...def: a short prefix, an ellipsis and a suffix in place of the key body. The documentation says the full value is available only in the creation response and that later retrieval returns a redacted value. It starts with the sk- stem shared with real keys but is not itself a key value. The documented example is illustrative; no page states how many characters of a real key a redacted display keeps.

sources.supports: ProjectAPIKey.redacted_value is the redacted value of the API key; example sk-abc...def.
The full API-key value is available only in the create response; later project API-key retrieval returns a redacted value.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. Class is unresolved: the sources establish that the display is redacted, not what a given redacted rendering does or does not reveal, and not how any consumer should treat it.
